assistant_settings_quiet_valid.name: assistant_settings_quiet_valid
assistant_settings_quiet_valid.value: NOT "assistant_settings"."quiet_enabled" OR ("assistant_settings"."quiet_start" IS NOT NULL AND "assistant_settings"."quiet_end" IS NOT NULL AND "assistant_settings"."quiet_start" <> "assistant_settings"."quiet_end")

agent_trace_subject.name: agent_trace_subject
agent_trace_subject.value: (CASE WHEN "agent_trace"."conversation_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) + (CASE WHEN "agent_trace"."assistant_test_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) + (CASE WHEN "agent_trace"."copilot_run_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1

experience_price.name: experience_price
experience_price.value: ("experience"."price_from" IS NULL) = ("experience"."currency" IS NULL) AND ("experience"."price_from" IS NULL OR "experience"."price_from" >= 0)

experience_image.name: experience_image
experience_image.value:
("experience"."image_url" IS NULL OR ("experience"."image_url" LIKE 'https://%' AND char_length("experience"."image_url") <= 2000))
        AND (("experience"."image_url" IS NULL) = ("experience"."image_width" IS NULL))
        AND (("experience"."image_url" IS NULL) = ("experience"."image_height" IS NULL))

upload_declared_size_range.name: upload_declared_size_range
upload_declared_size_range.value: "upload"."declared_size" > 0 AND "upload"."declared_size" <= CASE "upload"."purpose" WHEN 'media' THEN 157286400 WHEN 'document' THEN 20971520 ELSE 10485760 END

extra_name_valid.name: extra_name_valid
extra_name_valid.value:
jsonb_typeof("extra"."name") = 'object' AND "extra"."name" ? "extra"."source_language"
        AND char_length(coalesce("extra"."name"->>'es', 'x')) BETWEEN 1 AND 80
        AND char_length(coalesce("extra"."name"->>'en', 'x')) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

extra_time_needs_date.name: extra_time_needs_date
extra_time_needs_date.value: NOT "extra"."needs_time" OR "extra"."needs_date" OR "extra"."turnover" IS NOT NULL

extra_turnover_valid.name: extra_turnover_valid
extra_turnover_valid.value: "extra"."turnover" IS NULL OR ("extra"."turnover" IN ('early_check_in', 'late_checkout') AND NOT "extra"."needs_date")

service_request_note_len.name: service_request_note_len
service_request_note_len.value: "service_request"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("service_request"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

service_request_answered.name: service_request_answered
service_request_answered.value: ("service_request"."answered_by" IS NULL) OR ("service_request"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL)

guide_item_fact_key.name: guide_item_fact_key
guide_item_fact_key.value: ("guide_item"."kind" = 'fact') = ("guide_item"."fact_key" IS NOT NULL) AND ("guide_item"."fact_key" IS NULL OR "guide_item"."fact_key" IN ('check_in_time', 'checkout_time', 'max_guests', 'address'))

import_item_calendar_key.name: import_item_calendar_key
import_item_calendar_key.value: "import_item"."calendar_url_ciphertext" IS NULL OR "import_item"."data_key_id" IS NOT NULL

import_run_counts.name: import_run_counts
import_run_counts.value:
"import_run"."total" >= 0 AND "import_run"."processed" BETWEEN 0 AND "import_run"."total"
        AND "import_run"."created" >= 0 AND "import_run"."needs_details" >= 0 AND "import_run"."failed" >= 0 AND "import_run"."skipped" >= 0

workspace_plan_note_length.name: workspace_plan_note_length
workspace_plan_note_length.value: "workspace"."plan_note" IS NULL OR char_length("workspace"."plan_note") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

property_address_line1_length.name: property_address_line1_length
property_address_line1_length.value: "property"."address_line1" IS NULL OR char_length("property"."address_line1") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

property_address_parts_length.name: property_address_parts_length
property_address_parts_length.value:
("property"."address_unit" IS NULL OR char_length("property"."address_unit") <= 100)
        AND ("property"."region" IS NULL OR char_length("property"."region") <= 120)
        AND ("property"."postal_code" IS NULL OR char_length("property"."postal_code") <= 20)

property_city_length.name: property_city_length
property_city_length.value: "property"."city" IS NULL OR char_length("property"."city") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

property_source_provider_valid.name: property_source_provider_valid
property_source_provider_valid.value:
("property"."source_provider" IS NULL AND "property"."source" <> 'pms')
        OR ("property"."source_provider" IN ('beds24', 'hostex') AND "property"."source" = 'pms')

property_removed_fields.name: property_removed_fields
property_removed_fields.value:
("property"."status" = 'active' AND "property"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "property"."purge_after" IS NULL)
        OR ("property"."status" = 'removed' AND "property"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "property"."purge_after" IS NOT NULL)

restricted_value_public_wifi_only.name: restricted_value_public_wifi_only
restricted_value_public_wifi_only.value: "restricted_value"."public_value" IS NULL OR ("restricted_value"."kind" = 'wifi_password' AND char_length("restricted_value"."public_value") BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

calendar_feed_channel_label.name: calendar_feed_channel_label
calendar_feed_channel_label.value:
("calendar_feed"."channel" <> 'other' OR "calendar_feed"."channel_label" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("calendar_feed"."channel_label" IS NULL OR char_length("calendar_feed"."channel_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 40)

stay_source_links.name: stay_source_links
stay_source_links.value:
("stay"."source" = 'ical' AND "stay"."calendar_feed_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stay"."external_uid" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("stay"."source" = 'pms' AND "stay"."calendar_feed_id" IS NULL AND "stay"."external_uid" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("stay"."source" = 'manual' AND "stay"."calendar_feed_id" IS NULL AND "stay"."pms_connection_id" IS NULL)

stay_guest_fields.name: stay_guest_fields
stay_guest_fields.value:
("stay"."guest_name" IS NULL OR char_length("stay"."guest_name") <= 120)
        AND ("stay"."guest_count" IS NULL OR "stay"."guest_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 500)
        AND ("stay"."booking_reference" IS NULL OR char_length("stay"."booking_reference") <= 80)

stay_ical_no_guest_data.name: stay_ical_no_guest_data
stay_ical_no_guest_data.value: "stay"."source" <> 'ical' OR ("stay"."guest_name" IS NULL AND "stay"."guest_count" IS NULL AND "stay"."booking_reference" IS NULL)

pms_connection_credential_state.name: pms_connection_credential_state
pms_connection_credential_state.value:
("pms_connection"."status" = 'disconnected' AND "pms_connection"."credential_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "pms_connection"."disconnected_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("pms_connection"."status" <> 'disconnected' AND "pms_connection"."credential_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "pms_connection"."data_key_id" IS NOT NULL)
